scientific_integrity: The algebraic proof covers arbitrary fields; finite-field computations serve as independent finite checks, not as infinite proofs. No third-party scientific audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only cubic jets of the commutative symmetric algebra; not all radical-cube-zero algebras. Existing characteristic-two equivalence between idempotent derivations and binary gradings is prior work, not claimed new. Equivalent classifications in general grading literature remain a risk.
title: Idempotent derivations of cubic-truncated symmetric algebras over arbitrary fields
